body.text: Bring the socks you actually run or hike in, and the insoles if you use them. Staff watch you walk and jog, measure both feet, and pull three or four options before you try anything on. There is no charge for the fitting and no obligation to buy.

items: Wide and narrow sizes stocked in Longmont
Trail and road shoes, hiking boots

payload.inquiryPrompt: Want a fitting at a specific store or time? Ask and we will confirm availability.
payload.summary: A 20-minute fitting on the in-store treadmill with staff who look at how you land, not just what size you wear.
payload.title: Run and hike shoe fitting

body.text: Tuning runs November through April at the Longmont and Boulder stores. Drop-off is at the service counter; you will get a text when the gear is ready. Binding adjustments and safety checks need the boots and a signed release form.

items: Standard tune: base grind, edges, hot wax
Rush service when the bench is free

payload.inquiryPrompt: Not sure whether your bases need a grind or just a wax? Send a photo and we will tell you.
payload.summary: Base grind, edge work and hot wax, usually back within two days. Binding checks by appointment.
payload.title: Ski and snowboard tuning

body.text: Range Athletics is a fictional retailer created to demonstrate a multi-location business website. The stores, addresses, phone numbers and people on this site do not exist; the hours and services are realistic examples, not claims about any real business.
What a real store site would do

items: Publish hours per store with date exceptions, and say so when hours are unknown
List which services each store actually offers
Route questions to the store that can answer them

body.text: What it deliberately does not do
There is no inventory, no prices and no availability promise on this site. Those claims need a live connection to the stores' systems; without one, the honest choice is to let you ask.
Want to know whether a size is on the shelf? Send the store a question with the model and size and the floor staff will check.

payload.summary: The avalanche awareness evenings the tuning bench sends every new backcountry customer to, run by a fictional non-profit. Free; register on their site.
payload.title: Backcountry snow safety evenings

body.text: Boulder is the store for people who ride or run straight from the door. The bike counter is open whenever the store is, and Friday evenings run late into the night for group rides that end downtown.
Street parking is limited; the garage on Walnut is two blocks away. The entrance has a short ramp.

payload.summary: Downtown store near the creek path with a smaller shoe wall, a busy bike counter and Friday late hours for the trail crowd.
payload.title: Range Athletics Boulder

body.text: The Fort Collins store is closed while the sales floor is replaced. Team orders continue through the coordinator by phone and email, and shoe fittings are being handled in Longmont in the meantime.

payload.statusNote: Closed for floor replacement; team orders continue by phone
payload.summary: North store with the team-outfitting showroom. Temporarily closed for a floor replacement; reopening date to be announced.
payload.title: Range Athletics Fort Collins

body.text: Walk in for flats and quick adjustments; book for full tune-ups and suspension work. The Longmont shop has the suspension bench; Boulder handles most everything else.

items: Flats and quick fixes while you wait

payload.inquiryPrompt: Describe the noise or the problem and a mechanic will reply with what to expect.
payload.summary: Tune-ups, brake bleeds, wheel builds and flats while you wait, from mechanics who ride the same trails.
payload.title: Bike service

body.text: The Longmont store is the original and the largest. The shoe wall runs the length of the back, the service counter handles bikes year-round and skis in season, and the team-outfitting office is upstairs.
Free lot in front; the accessible entrance is the main door. Bike racks are beside the service bay.

payload.summary: Flagship store with the full shoe wall, the suspension bench and the winter tuning shop. Easy parking off Foothills Way.
payload.title: Range Athletics Longmont
